note: policy_name is the single policy naive/hybrid RAG are told to search — for multi_part questions this is deliberately just the first relevant policy, so the eval also shows naive/hybrid missing the other half of the answer, not just agentic winning on style points. expected_keywords are used for the offline accuracy grader in run_eval.py (fraction of these terms found, case-insensitive, in the returned answer).

questions.question: What is the standard security scan requirement before deploying to production?
How long is a security scan result considered valid?
Who is responsible for approving hotfix deployments?
What roles are authorized to deploy to production?
What does Section 4.2 of the security review policy say about how an override must be confirmed?
What is the SLA for responding to a critical-severity incident?
What does the production deployment policy say about deploying during an active critical incident?
What does Section 5 of the production deployment policy say about the override procedure?

For a repository with 3 consecutive failed deployments and an active critical incident, what is the complete required response: who to page, whether to halt all deployments, what approvals are needed for any emergency fix, and what the post-incident review must cover?
If a security scan returns Failed for a PR targeting production, what are all the options available to the engineer, who can authorize each one, and under what time constraints?
During an active critical incident that halted deployments, what are the requirements for an emergency hotfix PR, from scan validity through review through post-deployment follow-up?

A PR has a Failed security scan and is also unreviewed, and the deploying engineer wants to override and ship to production anyway — what does the production deployment policy require, and what does the security review policy separately require for the override to be valid?
